description: Accept a capital instrument an issuer offered - the investor taking the terms. Both sides stamped = agreed; the instrument is created once the issuer records your funds. Terms only, no money moves.

seller.description: The issuing firm's gerp_id (who published the offer).

thread.description: The negotiation thread, echoed from the offer.proposed you received.

terms_hash.description: The terms fingerprint, echoed from the offer.proposed — accepting the exact terms offered.

buyer.description: The investor's gerp_id / contact. Defaults to you (the caller); pass it to record an external investor's acceptance.
